name: See in the dark
summary: Most security cameras see in the dark with their own ring of infrared LEDs, invisible to the eye. Baby monitors with night vision are a ready-made camera and screen in one, and many run on 5V. For your own eyes, a dim red light keeps them adjusted to the dark.

parts.why: Security cameras and baby monitors see infrared
Infrared LEDs light a scene only cameras can see
Dim red lights keep your night vision
Small screens to view a camera
Portable power for camera and screen
Reflectors and lenses focus a light into a beam

tips: Your eyes take 20–30 minutes to adjust to the dark. One bright white light resets them.
Many phone cameras see some infrared. Check by pointing a TV remote at one and pressing a button.
Older analogue CCTV cameras run on 12V and plug into any TV with a yellow video input.
